title: Show HN: Immersive Gaussian Splat tour of grace cathedral, San Francisco
summary: An interactive web-based 3D tour of Grace Cathedral in San Francisco using Gaussian Splatting technology, enabling photorealistic real-time navigation through a historic religious landmark without specialized software.
problem_solved: Making photorealistic 3D architectural spaces accessible via web browsers without requiring specialized VR hardware or downloads
why_valuable: Demonstrates cutting-edge neural rendering techniques enabling museum-quality virtual exploration of real-world locations accessible to anyone with a browser
